title: Pandemic Legacy: Season 2
subtitle: A post-apocalyptic cooperative campaign to restore civilization from the sea
tagline: Seventy-one years after the fall, explore the grid and bring hope to humanity
loreSummary: You are the descendants of the few survivors sheltered in floating ocean stations known as Havens. With supplies dwindling, you must venture onto the shattered mainland and chart the forgotten world before all hope is lost.
keyFeatures: Scratch-off mainland map cards reveal unmapped cities and secret sea routes
Supply cube logistics system to keep surviving cities alive across the grid
Search deck mechanism uncovering equipment, hidden havens, and narrative secrets
Character progression with package tracking, abilities, and exposure scars

pandemic2_standard.name: Standard Campaign (Prologue + ~4 Retries)
pandemic2_standard.description: 1 training prologue plus 12 months with typical failure rate (~3-4 months requiring a 2nd attempt). Total 16-17 games.

pandemic2_optimistic.name: Flawless Haven Run (Prologue + 1-2 Retries)
pandemic2_optimistic.description: High win-rate expedition: 1 prologue and almost all months won on the first attempt (14 total games).

pandemic2_grind.name: Wasteland Struggle (Prologue + ~8 Retries)
pandemic2_grind.description: Struggling against collapsing supply lines and plague outbreaks; multiple months require late debriefings (21 total games).

pandemic2_max.name: Maximum Box Capacity (24 Games + Prologue)
pandemic2_max.description: Every single calendar month played twice (Early + Late) plus prologue missions for the fullest possible experience (26 total games).
